title: Encoded action reproduces a machine step
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$, input word $x$, and configuration $c$ on input $x$, applying the action encoded from $c$—using the machine's transition action when the state is present and a stationary, nonwriting halting action otherwise—gives exactly the configuration obtained by one step of $M$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x
